reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthWideCategories selection correctly, but writes its own #fixed regex instead of using the shared tag parser extractTagsFromText in #shared/tags (and with different, case-insensitive semantics).

duplication.why: No block duplication; only the tag-matching rule is a small parallel reimplementation of shared tag parsing.

placement.why: The rule lands in the shared month-wide category selection where the hidden/template exclusions already live; splitting the rule between SQL join and a JS post-filter is slightly awkward.

scope.why: Only the selection function and focused tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Small, documented and in one place; the bespoke regex can drift from the app's tag semantics (escaping with ##, case sensitivity).

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts FIXED_GROUP_TAG regex bypasses extractTagsFromText from #shared/tags

disguised_duplication.where: The regex is a reimplementation of tag detection, not a reshaped copy of existing code.

one_place.where: getMonthWideCategories in server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth and forEachMonthWideCategory (all month-wide actions).
